milestones.description: On Completion of Building foundation,pedastal, anchor bolts fixing, plinth beam,periphrial retaining wall , GP2, ATT, etc in 2 Installments for Block 1 ,2 & 4 and 4 Inslallments for Block 3.
On Completion of  Earthwork for plinth (1.2 mtr) i.e. cutting or filling from inside premises soil or filling from bought-out soil as per contour and proposed levels.

On completion of Brick /CC Block wall including tie beam ,stub columns, lintel beam, plastering, painting , openable/sliding aluminium windows with fixed mesh and pinhead glass,etc. in 2 installments.

On Completion of Grade slab (GSB, Vapour barrier, concrete, reinforcement, Hardner, FM-2, Groove cutting & filling, armour joints, dowels,etc.) -in 3 Installments for Block 1 & 4, 4-Installments in  Block-2 and 10 Inslallments for Block 3
On Completion of Mezzanine civil work (Including mezzanine foundations & 150mm grade slab).
On Completion of Fire Door Exit staircase with/without canopy ,MHE Ramp Civil work 5mx14.4m & dock opening angle.
SITC of Fire door ,MHE Manual Rolling shutter & Dock Motorized rolling shutter with dock bumpers
On Completion of Toilets Civil Work (Including 1 Handicap Toilet)
On Completion of Dock pits civil work including angle fixing -  to be filled with sand and FM2 floor (7 T capacity) to be casted. (without equipment)
On Completion of Warehouse entrance platform , steps, glass door and handicap ramp (Civil work, granite, SS railing , Facade 8m.x 6.5m. with glass canopy)

On Completion of Entry-2 - Warehouse entrance platform 5 mtr wide ,steps, glass panel door 1.5mX2.1m- 2 Nos and handicap ramp (Civil work, granite, SS railing)
It should be covered with glass canopy 5mx1.5m
SITC of Hydrant system - External Ring Main + Internal works including mezzanine - 80% Payment against supply & installation & 20% against testing & commissioning.
SITC of Sprinkler System - External Ring Main + Internal works including mezzanine - 80% Payment against supply & installation & 20% against testing & commissioning.
SITC of Fire detection system including mezzanine & toilets
SIT of Fire extinguishers
SITC of Internal warehouse lighting including below mezzanine lighting of 200 Lux and canopy lighting 100 Lux - including light fixtures & cables.
SITC of Toilets lighting including light fixtures & cables.

SITC of Inside warehouse LT Work - Sub-distribution Panel with incomer of EB and Outgoing Feeder 4 nos feeding to Dock leveler and Motorised Rolling Shutter DB's, Toilet DB's, Lighting DB's, Power DB, ELB DB,fire door electrical point and fire door exit outside light.(The sub-distribution panel of warehouse will feed lighting,dock levellers, motorised rolling shutters-the main LT panel of warehouse is not in D&B Scope)
SITC of Building earthing grid and lightening protection system
SIT of Dock pits - conduits, electrical industrial socket ,DB's and cables.

SITC of Mechanical Ventilation- SITC of Industrial type 12 inch, 1400 rpm. fan in each cubicle i.e. W/C ,Janitor, bath cubicle etc. 
For common urinal area - a minumum of 2 nos. of exhaust fan with 18 inch 2550 CFM industrial type is required.
SITC of Toilet Plumbing Work

milestones.description:
On completion of Land Development- Cleaning, Cutting, filling , Backfilling, soil filling bought-out from outside & compaction of Soil for Warehouses upto plinth level (+1.2), external infra, ancillary buildings, green area, OSR, etc. 
Cutting & Filling to be done as per NGL & Proposed Finished Levels in 4 installments.
On completion of Road work (Incl. plot access ramp/road), Aprons, Non-Movement Road - complete in all respect in 10 Installments
On completion of all type of Pathway/Walkway including Kerb Stone in 4 Installments
On completion of Open Parking (Car & Truck Parking) in 3 Installments

On Completion of Barricading for Operation of Block 1 & 2 and Construction of Block 3 & 4.
10 feet height GI sheet with MS Structure barrication.
On Completion of MS Fencing with retaining wall, 5 Feet Height Barbed Wire Fencing outside boundary wall,Retaining Wall (Near Ramp at front & OSR 2) in 2 Installments.
On completion of Landscaping work (OSR & Green Area with Lawn & Trees including irrigation system 2 Installments
On completion of following Utility Buildings :-
On completion of LT Room Civil Complete Work - in 2 Installments
On completion of Pump Room-Civil including Trench & Pump foundations - in 2 Installments
On completion of Driver rest Room with toilets facility-Civil-Complete room - in 2 Installments

On completion of Guard Room with Toilet - Site entry-Civil -Complete Work , Openable motorised Gate at Main Entry and Exit of 2 meter height,Wicket gates for entry and exit of 2 meter height, SITC of Boom barrier - Arm length of road width (Arm length should not be more than 3.5 meters for single boom barrier) and SITC of FMO (40feet porta container) with TOILET + AC + Furniture including foundation. -in 2 Installments
On completion of HT Meter/RMU Area with 1.8 mtr MS fencing and gravel

On completion of DG Foundations & DG's stack Structure of 18M height from FRL including Insulation and GI Cladding on smoke pipes and smoke pipe will connect to DG set considering smoke pipe dia. for 200KVA DG as  200 mm. NB & 250 mm. NB  considering back pressure. Including Civil Work..

On completion of Electrical Substation including foundation of Transformer, HT VCB, RCC Trench and respective panels foundations. The yard includes gravel and 1.8 m height peripharal Chain Link Fencing as well.

On completion of Separate Road crossing for tanent (Hume pipe for utilities) 45 meter per lac (3-4 location ) of each warehouse  200 mm dia Np3 pipe 2 Installments.
Underground Crossings for Proposed Substation to warehouses.
Underground RCC Trench with pre-cast slab along Boundary Wall.
Over Ground MS Structure (Clear 600mm wide) for Proposed Route for Tenant Substation. 
: 2 Installments
On completion of 10,000 Ltr effective capacity of underground RCC water tank with pump (One working + One Standby) to fill the Fire & Domestic Modular Tanks of 12 mtr height

On completion of OHT will be placed on PEB Structure of Block-1 on gable end site at a height of 12 meters from FFL.
Separate MS Structure not to be considered for OHT.
Booster pumps, pipelines, modular tank to be considered.
Over Head Tank of 20,000 liters effective capacity in 3 Modular Tanks, all boxes-common header to be connected with this OHT for fire (consider pipeline accordingly)
On Completion of Sump pit min. 2.5x2.5x2.5and with pumps with GI line from sump to STP:  2 Installments
SITC of RO + Chiller/water coller with dispenser with foundation and cover shed - 100 LPH- ion exchange.

On completion of 18 Meter Height, 3 sided LED display of 6.38mtrX1.8mtr on the top of pole including Civil Foundation, Structural & Electrical work & conceptual drawing
On completion of Enterance Portal as per 3D view in specs sheet and masterlayout plan & conceptual drawing
On completion of Client Vertical Pylon as per 3D view in specs sheet & conceptual drawing.
:In 3 Installments
On completion of External Signage & Bollard in 2 Installments

On completion of Storm Water Drain will be U-Type RCC Drain of Open & Covered Type both as per design and road movement with Brick/RCC Chambers with Heavy duty/light duty covers as per requirement. No any drain will be open in docking area side.
:In 5 Installments
On Completion of Sewage line with chambers in 3 Installments
On completion of Plumbing Work-Internal Plumbing Works , external water supply and Hydropneumatic pumps 6 Installments
On completion of STP Work (Civil) in 3 Installments
On completion of STP Work (Mechanical) :In 2 Installments
On completion of Organic Waste Converter (OWC) with Shed - Waste capacity per day of 300 Kg
On SITC of Raw Water Tank, Treated Water Tank and Fire Tank work including Civil Work- 4 Installments

On Completion of Plumbing works of Utility Buildings (Pump Room, Driver rest room, guard room, RO Chiller ,FMO Container, etc.) & 
Borewell - 1 No. borewell of up to 200 feet depth and 200mm dia bore with pump.
Plumbing connection from Borewell to Raw water tank and automation for borewell functioning. In 2 Installments

On completion of Pond of required effective capacity with clear 1200 mm wide brickwork Staircase with MS railing,No bores and no filter media.
Pond will have tapered walls at 45 degree with Stone pitching on sides & bottom of pond and 1800mm chain fencing with inlet RCC hume pipe of storm water and overflow discharge RCC hume pipe towards nearby water body.
Also, a cleaning sump is to be provided at the bottom of Pond  along with Pump for Cleaning Purpose. Pond to be covered with mosquito net in 2 installments.
On Completion of PEB Roof Profile Machine Foundation as per drawing for all blocks- 4 Installments

SITC of HT infra including HT RMU.
SITC of HT Cable from HT meter to  RMU and then RMU to HT Panel of Infra inside premises, HT Panel of Infra to Transformer HT Box,Earthing: In 2 Installments

SITC of LT Infra including LT Breaker,LT Cable from main LT Breaker to Warehouse sub distribution Panel including Infra Main Panel, Bus Bar, Earthing, APFC Panel , Distribution Panel for Warehouses Utility and Pump Room. In 2 Installments

SITC of 630 kVA transformer for common utility instruments/machines+ Pump Rooms. 
Transformer shall be provided along with OLTC & shall be energy efficiency class 2 as per IS 1180 (Part-1): 2010 and latest amendment 2024.
SITC of CAM DG -200 KVA -CPCB-4 for infra with all required accessories such as AMF and ATS in panels, complete for operations.

SITC of Internal  Electrical wiring, light fixtures, cabling and panels & mechanical Ventilation for utility building, Drivers room,LT Room,  Meter room, security room, Pump room ,FMO, Chiller, Boom Barrier, Main Gate , pond, underground tank, DG stack aviation light, transformer area, two pole area,OSR and green area ,signage electrical provision ,STP, etc. In 2 Installments
SITC of External lighting (roads & parking) In 2 Installments
SITC of Flood lighting 150w in apron areas In 2 Installments

SITC of CCTV System for surveillance of complete park excuding inside warehouses with control room setup in Security Room / FMO container with HD picture quality and clear night vision. In 2 Installments
SITC of Hydrant system - pump room equipment such as electrical & diesel pumps,  & external piping - 80% Payment against supply & installation & 20% against testing & commissioning.
SITC of Sprinkler System - pump room equipment such as electrical & diesel pumps & external piping - 80% Payment against supply & installation & 20% against testing & commissioning.
SITC of Fire Detection in all utility buildings and Fire Protection System in Pump Room and fire extinguishers in all utility buildings and infra. In 2 Installments
